Orienting players inside a technical investigation.

Early Microsoft cybersecurity-learning prototypes combine role-specific missions, technical exercises and persistent support tools.

ProjectMicrosoft Squire
Contribution / source recordKeep this linked to the Microsoft work until project boundaries are confirmed.

Design approach

  • Role briefings explain what to investigate, remediate and prevent.
  • A recurring toolkit keeps journal, policy, chat and help accessible alongside the activity.
  • Timing notes document coordination between different player roles and technical tasks.

Why this work matters

The useful design story is maintaining orientation as players move between narrative, collaboration and unfamiliar technical work.
